VI.description: Headless DQMH Rename Module. Renames ONE DQMH module in the ACTIVE project by calling Delacor's own scripting VIs as STATIC subVIs - the chain Delacor's Module\5CRename DQMH Module.vi runs behind its dialog\2C with no dialog and no keystroke.\0A\0AChain\3A lvdqmh_pick_event.vi with an empty Event Name (parse\2C pick the module by NAME\2C close the other modules) -> Scripter - Rename Module.vi with the module\2C New Module Name and Parse's My Computer reference -> lvdqmh_close_modules.vi. The scripter renames the library and moves every file to a folder of the new name\2C renames the tester\2C deletes the old folder and ends with Save All This Project.\0A\0AWHY ONE HIERARCHY. Module Info carries thirteen refnums that LabVIEW releases when the top-level VI that opened them stops\2C so the parse and the scripter must run under one top-level VI.\0A\0ADRY RUN BY DEFAULT. Script? FALSE parses and reports only. Scripting also needs the module found\2C no locked and no unsaved module - Delacor's rename dialog refuses unsaved modules too - and no error. Library Names lists every library in the project as Delacor's dialog checks it. Library Owning Folder is the folder BEFORE the rename. Not found is not an error\3A Module Index -1. Scripted? says whether the scripter was called.\0A\0ANO MODAL DIALOG ON PURPOSE. Delacor's dialog checks New Module Name with Is Name Multiplatform.vi and against every library in the project\2C and answers a failure with a One Button Dialog\3B a modal stops LabVIEW's gRPC service\2C so those checks are NOT made here. The caller must refuse a blank\2C invalid or colliding name - compared case-insensitively with .lvlib appended\2C as Delacor does - before Script? is TRUE. New Module Name carries no .lvlib. The scripter is never handed an incoming error.\0A\0ARequires DQMH installed\2C a project OPEN AND ACTIVE in the IDE\2C and lvdqmh_pick_event.vi and lvdqmh_close_modules.vi loaded. Generated by LabVIEWMCP\3B the Delacor VIs it calls belong to the user's DQMH installation and are not shipped with it.

FreeLabel.comment: Scripts only when Script? is TRUE
